instruction: Create an ORIGINAL PURE-DART reusable package named aivexus_rotate_left, Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. Implement exactly this PUBLIC TOP-LEVEL Dart function in lib/rotate_left.dart: List<int> rotateLeft(List<int> input, int steps). Return a new list rotated left by steps positions with wraparound. Steps may be positive, zero, larger than length or negative (negative means right shift). Empty input gives empty output for any steps. Do not mutate input. Fully implement working behavior yourself, not a stub. Write reasonable tests under test/. You may use Dart core List, Map, Set, loops and standard library methods only. No third-party runtime dependencies, networking, filesystem, FFI, shell or privileged APIs. Always use valid Dart SDK APIs and compileable types. Return the strict JSON source object requested by the system prompt.
